content: I know CaDiCaL is used internally by some tactics. Is there a way to interface with it from within a program?
bv_decide uses it internally by calling it as a subprocess
As I learned here, the command bv_decide uses to call Cadical is Lean.Elab.Tactic.BVDecide.Frontend.runExternal. It returns a solution, or a LRAT proof. Which one of these are you interested in?
